topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Hey, I just heard about this, and my mind's spinning a bit. Moving across the country, huh? That’s a huge deal, and I can’t even begin to imagine what you must be thinking right now. It’s like, one minute we’re just hanging out, planning all our future stuff, and the next, everything shifts. I’m here for you, no matter what. We can do video calls, and I’ll come visit whenever I can. It’s not going to be the same, but we’ll make it work. We always do. Just promise me one thing—don’t let this change us. We’re in this together, okay?
